summary.result: Results suggest that anoxic conditions were developed during submersion, and that As or heavy metals (particularly Cd) fractions bound to ferrous (Fe) /manganese (Mn) oxides were easily dissociated.
summary.background: There have been only a few studies focused on the stabilization of metal (loid)s in anaerobic soils such as paddy soils.
summary.method: In this study, laboratory-scale column tests were conducted to artificially manipulate anoxic conditions in submerged paddy fields and we observed the release behavior of As, Cd, Pb, and Zn, as well as to examine the stabilization effect of steel refining slag (SRS) on the metal(loid)s.

summary_ko.method: 본 연구에서는 인공적으로 수분된 논밭에서 무산소 조건을 조절하기 위해 실험실 규모의 컬럼 실험을 수행하여 As, Cd, Pb, Zn의 용출특성을 관찰하였으며, 제강슬래그(SRS)가 중금속(loid)에 대한 안정화 효과를 평가하였다.
summary_ko.result: 결과적으로 수분 시 무산소 조건이 형성되었으며, Fe 또는 Mn 산화물에 결합한 As 또는 중금속(특히 Cd) 분획이 쉽게 분리되는 것으로 나타났다.
